subject: DPA + SCCs: coordination and evidence checklist
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.inference.com>
To: Susan Fleming <susan.fleming@novumedhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: DPA + SCCs: coordination and evidence checklist

Hi Susan,

Thanks again for the productive call earlier — appreciate you walking us through Novum's internal signoff path. Per our discussion, attaching the current MSA + order form redline bundle and a first-pass DPA tailored for the EU market. Highlights:

- We propose using the standard SCCs model clause (Annex V in our template) and have mapped subprocessor roles in the attached redwood-sccs-mapping.pdf.
- For Novum's hosting requirement (EU-only processing), see the attached evidence-hosting-diagram.png — this shows our VPC private-hosting option and how we can pin region to eu-west-1.
- A few items we expect you'll flag in the DPA: transfer addendum language, controller/processor role delegations, and the training-carveout clause.

As next steps: can you confirm (1) who on your side will own legal redlines (name/email), (2) whether the procurement team needs a separate pricing worksheet, and (3) whether SOC2 evidence is sufficient or you need raw audit artifacts?

I copied Karthik for technical clarifications and Ben for procurement logistics. We'll assemble the evidence binder on our side once we know Novum's priority items.

Attachments: Novum_DPA_Redline_v1.docx, redwood-sccs-mapping.pdf, evidence-hosting-diagram.png

Best,
Jordan
Jordan Blake | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Susan Fleming <susan.fleming@novumedhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Novum Legal <legal@novumedhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 10:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: DPA + SCCs: coordination and evidence checklist

Jordan —

Thanks for the materials. Our GC (Claire Hammond) will own the legal redlines and I'm looping her in on this thread (she is on legal@novumedhealth.com). Initial read: the DPA has good structure but there are three items we need clarified before legal completes the mark-up:

1) Transfer addendum: we need explicit fallback routing if eu-west-1 is unavailable — is there an agreed list of acceptable fallback regions?
2) Processor vs Controller: clause 2.1 (role split) is a little ambiguous for the embedding feature — we need a clearer statement that Novum is controller for customer data and Redwood's embedding vector representations are processor-generated outputs; confirm retention policy for vectors.
3) Subprocessors: can you provide a short list of active subprocessors for EU processing (host, monitoring, analytics) and dates when they were last assessed?

Also, Claire asked whether you can provide the SOC2 report and a short note on data deletion/sep purge timelines. We do not need raw logs but would like the evidence pack consolidated as a single drive folder and a DocuSign-ready MSA + order form after redlines are reconciled.

Best,
Susan
Susan Fleming | Head of Procurement, Novum Health
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.inference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: DPA + SCCs: coordination and evidence checklist

Forwarding Novum's initial redline asks — Claire (Novum GC) will own legal edits. Key asks we need to resolve before we return a DocuSign bundle: fallback region list, vector retention policy clarity, subprocessors and SOC2 evidence packaging.

Laura — can you take the lead on the legal redline and propose language for (1) fallback region wording that preserves EU-only commitment but allows a narrow, audited fallback, and (2) sharpen controller/processor language for embeddings and retention?

Karthik — can you prepare a short technical note (bullet list) that covers: current subprocessors + assessment dates, retention/TTL for embedding vectors (default, configurable), and how the KV cache vs persisted vectors are handled. If we can get that by EOD tomorrow I can synthesize into a single response to Novum and attach the SOC2 cert and evidence link.

Ben — procurement: Novum asked about pricing worksheet — can you confirm whether we should send the standard reserved-capacity worksheet or a usage-based cost estimate? Also highlight any discount thresholds that need executive signoff.

Thanks — Jordan

Subject: Re: DPA + SCCs: coordination and evidence checklist

Hi Susan / Claire —

Appreciate the clear asks. Quick update and attachments: SOC2 Type II certificate attached and a short evidence folder (link below). Karthik's technical note is attached inline and I've summarized the procurement points.

- Fallback regions: primary eu-west-1; acceptable fallback list (ordered): eu-central-1, eu-west-3. Fallback will only be used under documented incident conditions and is subject to prior notification and temporary restrictions in the DPA Annex. Laura has proposed draft fallback wording (see attached redline).

- Embedding retention: default retention for embedding vectors is 30 days; we can offer a 90-day configurable option for enterprise customers in the order form. Vectors are treated as derived data (processor outputs) and are purged per the retention schedule — see Karthik's note for details on TTL and the purge job cadence.

- Subprocessors: current EU-active subprocessors: HostCo EU (hosting, last assessed 2026-03-15), MoniTrack (monitoring, last assessed 2025-11-08), Analytica (analytics, last assessed 2026-01-22). Karthik attached the short assessment summary.

Procurement: for Novum's expected profile the recommended starting quote is usage-based with a 12-month ROI clause; we can add reserved capacity pricing if Novum prefers predictable throughput. Any discount above 20% needs VP approval — flagged in the pricing worksheet.

Next actions: Jordan to reconcile Laura's redline with Novum_DPA_Redline_v1.docx and return a DocuSign-ready MSA + order form. We're also uploading the evidence pack here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example

Attachments: SOC2_Redwood_TypeII.pdf, procurement-pricing-worksheet.xlsx, k_i_note_embedding_retention.pdf, Laura_redline_fallback_clauses.docx

Thanks,
Ben Carter | Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
